boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University at Buffalo
boards.description: Late-evening food and snack destinations with currently published hours from UB Dining or the business itself.

cards.title: Main Street Market
cards.subtitle: Goodyear Hall, South Campus
cards.notes: Head to Goodyear Hall for the 9–11 p.m. weekday service window; confirm the academic-calendar schedule before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A South Campus option with a clearly posted late-night weekday service period.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists Main Street Market’s regular weekday hours as 7 a.m.–3 p.m. and 9–11 p.m., and identifies Late Night meal exchanges.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 9:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. for the late service window; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Hubies
cards.subtitle: Ellicott Food Court, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the Ellicott Food Court’s weekday 5–11 p.m. window for pizza, wings, chicken fingers, or subs; check for break-hour changes.
cards.short_summary: A North Campus food-court counter with service posted through 11 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists Hubies in the Ellicott Food Court as open Monday–Friday from 5–11 p.m. and accepting Late Night meal exchanges on weekdays.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 5:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m.; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Perks
cards.subtitle: Ellicott Food Court, North Campus
cards.notes: Stop by the Ellicott Food Court counter before its 11 p.m. weekday close for coffee, tea, baked goods, bubble tea, or ice cream.
cards.short_summary: A late-open coffee and treats counter in the Ellicott Food Court.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists Perks’ regular Monday–Friday hours as 8 a.m.–11 p.m. and describes coffee, tea, baked goods, bubble tea, and ice cream.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: The Cellar
cards.subtitle: Governors Complex, North Campus
cards.notes: Plan around the 9–11 p.m. weekday reopening in Governors Complex; check UB Dining’s current schedule when classes are not in session.
cards.short_summary: A Governors Complex diner with an explicitly posted late weekday window.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists The Cellar’s regular Monday–Friday hours as 8 a.m.–3 p.m. and 9–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 9:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. for the late service window; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Jim's Steakout on Main
cards.subtitle: 3094 Main St., Buffalo
cards.notes: For an off-campus option near South Campus, use the Main Street location’s posted walk-in closing time and order before the final minutes.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant whose official location page posts food-service hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim’s Steakout lists its 3094 Main St. location open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday, with walk-in orders accepted until closing.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours for 3094 Main St.: 10:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; online ordering can stop earlier.

cards.title: Ellicott Food Court vending
cards.subtitle: Ellicott Complex, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the listed food-court vending machines when counters are closed; bring a payment method accepted by the machine and choose from stocked items.
cards.short_summary: A named residence-hall food-court destination with 24-hour UB Snackin’ machines.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Ellicott Food Court among locations with Just Baked, Fresh Food, and Health & Wellness machines.
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and specifically lists Ellicott Food Court as a vending location.

cards.title: Lockwood Library vending
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Library, North Campus
cards.notes: If you are already at Lockwood, use the second-floor vending location for a snack or drink after restaurant service has ended.
cards.short_summary: A library destination with a specifically listed second-floor UB Snackin’ location.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Lockwood Library’s second floor among North Campus vending locations.
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Lockwood’s second floor as a vending location.

cards.title: Student Union vending
cards.subtitle: Student Union, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the first- or second-floor machine listed by UB Dining for a purchased snack or beverage when the Union’s food counters are closed.
cards.short_summary: A central campus destination with vending locations on two floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists the Student Union’s first and second floors among North Campus vending locations.
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists the Student Union’s first and second floors as vending locations.

cards.title: Alumni Arena vending
cards.subtitle: Alumni Arena, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the basement or first-floor machines listed by UB Dining for a late purchased snack; Fresh Food machines are noted at this destination.
cards.short_summary: An arena destination with listed basement and first-floor vending, including Fresh Food machines.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Alumni Arena’s basement and first floor, including Fresh Food machines, as vending locations.
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Alumni Arena basement and first floor as vending locations.

cards.title: Capen Hall vending
cards.subtitle: Capen Hall, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the first-floor vending location listed by UB Dining for a purchased snack or drink after evening plans; verify building access separately.
cards.short_summary: A named North Campus academic-building destination with a listed vending stop.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Capen Hall’s first floor among North Campus vending locations.
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Capen Hall’s first floor as a vending location.
